name: Mayor's Office
title: Mayor
hours: Monday to Friday. The city lists 8 AM to 4 PM (closed noon to 1 PM) on one page and 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM on another, so call ahead.
summary: The Mayor runs the city departments day to day, works with the council on policy and the budget, and votes as a council member.

name: City Clerk
title: City Clerk
summary: The City Clerk keeps the official city records, council agendas and minutes. Teja McIntyre was sworn in on July 23, 2026.

name: Permits, Business Licenses and Facility Rentals
title: Permits, Business Licenses and Rentals
summary: Call or email here for building permits, business licenses, alcohol license applications and questions about renting a city building.

name: Accounts Payable and Receivable
title: Accounts Payable and Receivable
summary: This office handles payments the city makes and receives, so vendors and anyone with a billing question should start here.

name: Human Resources
title: Human Resource Director
summary: Human Resources handles city jobs and employee questions. The city's job page showed no open positions on Oct. 30, 2026.

name: Hanceville Fire and Rescue
title: Fire chief post vacant after Oct. 8, 2026
summary: The fire department answers calls around the clock. Use the non emergency line for burn permits, the free smoke alarm program and general questions, and call 911 in an emergency. The council upheld the removal of the fire chief on Oct. 8, 2026, and no replacement had been named when we checked.

name: Law Enforcement
title: Non emergency line
summary: The city dissolved its police department and municipal court in February 2026, and Cullman County deputies have been patrolling Hanceville since. The council is working on policies to bring back a city police department. Call 911 for any emergency.

name: Storm Shelters
title: Opens the shelters during a Tornado Watch
summary: Public Works opens three city storm shelters during a Tornado Watch. Each holds 90 people. They are behind the library at 202 Bangor Avenue SE, at C.W. Day Park at 203 Michelle Street NW and in Steppville at 1407 Commercial Street SE.

name: Public Works
title: City Operations Manager
summary: Public Works repairs streets, picks up brush and fixes street lights. Report a pothole, a fallen tree or a light that is out by calling City Hall.

name: Hanceville Water and Sewer Board
title: Manager
summary: The water board runs water and sewer service for the Hanceville area. Call here to start or stop service, report a leak or ask about a bill, or pay your bill online.

name: Parks and Recreation
title: Parks Director
summary: Parks and Recreation runs the four city parks, the city pool and youth sports. You can reserve and pay for park facilities online through the city's Jarvis rental site.

name: Shirley Burden Public Library
title: Library Manager
hours: Tuesday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM (closed noon to 1 PM), Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, closed Sunday and Monday.
summary: The city library offers books, storytimes and programs for all ages, plus a small used book shop that supports its children's programs.

name: Planning Commission
title: Contact to get on the agenda
hours: Meets the fourth Monday of each month at 6 PM at the Civic Center.
summary: The Planning Commission handles zoning, land subdivision and the city master plan. The city asks anyone who wants to be on the agenda to email the Mayor. Vice Chair Steve Barnett and Secretary Rhonda Jett are among its nine members.

name: Events and Community Development Committee
title: Chair
hours: Meets the first Monday of each month at 6 PM at the library.
summary: This advisory committee helps plan city events, build ties with local businesses and recommend ways to improve life in Hanceville. Brianna Powell is co chair and Morgan Wasilewski is secretary. Meetings are open to the public.

name: Cullman County Satellite Office
title: Tags, titles and property taxes
summary: A county satellite office inside City Hall handles car tags, titles, mobile home renewals and property taxes, so you can skip the drive to Cullman.
